name: sketch snaps into precise angled diagram
looks: A squiggly hand-drawn line is traced across a dark grid by a small pen glyph at its tip, under the words "SKETCH IT." The line then straightens and snaps into a clean isometric diagram with right angles, with length and angle labels (degrees, feet-and-inches) popping in at each corner, under a new headline, and a confirm button fades up.
build: freehand-to-precision-snap: a hand-jittered SVG path revealed with strokeDashoffset, point-lerped to a straightened target set on back.out(1.6) over about 0.25 s, with angle-arc and length callouts staggering in 0.06 s apart at each vertex. The headline swap is a hard cut.
sound: A soft pencil-scratch texture under the sketch, a crisp snap on the straighten, a tick per callout.
prompt: Show a rough, hand-drawn sketch being traced across a technical grid, with a plain headline labelling the step. At the instant the sketch completes, snap it into a precise, straight-edged diagram of the same shape, with measurement callouts popping in at each corner and a second headline naming the payoff. Close on a small confirm action.
